explanation: L0/N847+ is a retrospective, context-free unigram detector: a position's strength is a fixed function of that position's token id alone (input attribution puts 100% of the drive on the peak token and 0% on any context, and per-token values computed under two unrelated prefixes correlate at 1.0000), so it reads which piece is present and never the sentence, and with a hard floor (56% of the 50,304-token vocabulary reads ~0, only 456 pieces exceed 0.6 of its 1.27 scan maximum) it is a graded detector, not a dial. The firing table is the vocabulary's loanword / proper-name / specialist tail: word-initial fragments of long Latinate or Greek words (compar-, manif-, arthro-, chond-, macroph-, neuropathy, antifer-, cryptocur-, homeost-, jurisd-, oligonucleotide, immunohist-), non-English pieces (' wa', ' ч', ' ö', 'ä', ' toim', ' ovat', ' pä', ' kö', ' св', ' ü', 'õ'), name fragments (' Sche', ' Schul', ' Schw', ' McG', ' McCl', ' Niss', ' Hö', ' Hof', ' Wilcoxon', ' Getty') and the English inquiry/assessment families (compar*/comparison/compared/comparing, try/trying/tried, look/looking, focus/focusing, attempt/attempted, evaluate/evaluated, examine/examined, scrutinize, critics, struggling, aimed), whereas the whole high-frequency core - every determiner, preposition, conjunction, auxiliary and pronoun, all punctuation, digits and whitespace runs, and common content words such as 'fact', 'many', 'good', 'recent', 'summary', 'permit' - reads exactly 0; the tilt is not a frequency, POS, language, length or orthography rule, since ' comparison' hits the maximum on 7.4k corpus occurrences while rarer ' hypothesis', ' algorithm', ' chromosome', ' municipality', ' heterogeneous', ' London', ' Harvard' and ' adjud' all read ~0, so treat the firing set as the fixed table it is.
